name: Cryptic crossword No 24,603
preamble: Thirteen solutions are of a set, one of which is here translated into its own language. None of these is further defined.

clue.text: France's eastern mountains form a barrier

blocks.note: est is the French word for east
a range is a chain of mountains

explanation.surface: The Vosges and Jura on France's eastern border have long stood as a natural barrier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'France's eastern' asks for the French word, not an abbreviation such as E.
explanation.definitionFit: To estrange people is to put a wall between them, driving them apart until they no longer get along.

clue.text: One from one in pride to wear with it

indicators.note: taking something from a word removes it, leaving the rest behind

blocks.note: the Roman numeral for one
a pride is a group of lions, so one member of it is a lion
to don clothes is to put them on and wear them

explanation.surface: A lion is invited to dress up and join the trendy set.
explanation.walkthrough: 'With it' looks like the slang for fashionable, but it only links the parts. The preamble's set is European capitals, so this answer has no definition of its own.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital of the United Kingdom, a European capital city, belongs to the thematic set the preamble names instead of a definition.

clue.text: Perks from inversion of royal film

indicators.note: an inversion turns the order over, so the two parts swap places

blocks.note: a royal film is a king's film
pic is informal for a film or picture

explanation.surface: Someone makes money on the side by turning a royal movie upside down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Royal film' reads as KING'S PIC; the inversion puts the second word first.
explanation.definitionFit: Pickings are the extra gains or spoils that come with a position, the same informal sense as fringe benefits.

clue.text: Fighting words

blocks.note: war is large-scale fighting
a saw is a saying, a set of wise words

explanation.walkthrough: The capital of Poland is one of the preamble's set and is not otherwise defined; 'Fighting words' sounds like a phrase for provocative talk.
explanation.definitionFit: Poland's capital city is one of the thirteen European capitals the preamble groups together without separate definitions.

clue.text: Section of motorboat

indicators.note: a section is only a part, so only some of the letters are kept

blocks.note: the opening section of the word motor
a scow is a flat-bottomed boat

explanation.walkthrough: The surface splits 'motorboat' as one word, but the wordplay needs 'motor' and 'boat' apart. The capital of Russia is one of the preamble's set.
explanation.definitionFit: Russia's capital city is one of the thirteen European capitals the preamble groups together without separate definitions.

clue.text: Virgin securing therapist

indicators.note: to secure something is to hold it fast, so one piece is held inside another

blocks.note: a maid is a virgin, as in the Maid of Orleans
DR, doctor, stands for one who treats patients

explanation.surface: A young woman takes on a counsellor to help her.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital of Spain is one of the preamble's set and has no definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Spain's capital city is one of the thirteen European capitals the preamble groups together without separate definitions.

clue.text: Country's ingratitude

indicators.note: something in another is placed within it

blocks.note: a country of the Middle East
ta is British slang for thank you

explanation.surface: A nation is accused of being ungrateful.
explanation.walkthrough: Split 'ingratitude' into 'in gratitude' and the country sits inside the thanks. The capital of Albania belongs to the preamble's set.
explanation.definitionFit: Albania's capital city is one of the thirteen European capitals the preamble groups together without separate definitions.

clue.text: How row starts on keyboard

blocks.note: the middle row of letters on a keyboard begins A, followed by S

explanation.surface: A typist wonders which keys begin a line on the keyboard.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is a question answered by 'A then S', the first two keys of the home row. The capital of Greece is one of the preamble's set.
explanation.definitionFit: Greece's capital city is one of the thirteen European capitals the preamble groups together without separate definitions.

clue.text: Cowboy in Oz hit on a way to break resistance

indicators.note: done in another way, the letters take a new order
breaking into something means getting inside it

blocks.note: taken as written
to make a stand is to resist

explanation.surface: An Australian cowboy stumbles on a method to overcome opposition.
explanation.walkthrough: Oz is Australia. 'Hit on' looks like a phrasal verb meaning discover, but its letters, with 'a', are the anagram fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: In Australia a station is a big sheep or cattle ranch, and the hired worker there does a cowboy's job.

clue.text: Dearly beloved getting a note of warning?

blocks.note: taken as written
do (doh) is the first note of the sol-fa scale
red is the colour of warning

explanation.surface: A wedding congregation is solemnly cautioned by the minister.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dearly beloved' opens the marriage service, which suggests the vicar, but here it is simply the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone held very dear and deeply loved is worshipped by their admirer, an equivalent past participle.

clue.text: Accepts party discipline and prepares to address mount

blocks.note: in Parliament the whip is the party's instruction on how to vote, which a loyal member obeys
a rider about to urge on a horse picks up the crop

explanation.surface: A politician toes the line and gets ready to speak to a mountain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Address' suggests a speech and 'mount' a hill; here a mount is a horse and to address it is to deal with it. In British politics the whip is the party's voting instruction.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase covers both a member submitting to party orders in Parliament and a jockey picking up a riding crop.

clue.text: 1 in 2

indicators.note: placed in something means held within it

blocks.note: the digit one becomes the letter that looks like it
the answer to 2 down is nicknamed the Great Wen, a wen being a swelling

explanation.walkthrough: The numbers look like cross-references, and 2 is: Cobbett called London the Great Wen. This is the capital the preamble says is translated into its own language: Vienna in German.
explanation.definitionFit: Austria's capital city, given in German rather than English, is the set member the preamble says appears in its own language.

clue.text: Unaware when making observation about return of unglamorous expert

indicators.note: a return goes back the way it came
about means around, so one piece goes round another

blocks.note: noting something is observing or remarking on it
a wonk is a studious, nerdy specialist

explanation.surface: Someone comments on a geeky specialist coming back, without realising it.
explanation.walkthrough: Wonk is American slang for a swot or policy nerd, which is why the expert is unglamorous.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking knowledge of something, being in the dark about it, is the same state as being oblivious.

clue.text: Large number of grains after shelter for 45 minutes?

indicators.note: coming after means placed at the end of what precedes it

blocks.note: a tent is a canvas shelter
three quarters of an hour is three quarters of the word HOUR
sand is made of tiny grains

explanation.surface: Countless grains of sand collect in a tent during a short stay on the beach.
explanation.walkthrough: '45 minutes' is not a time but a fraction: three-quarters of the four letters of HOUR.
explanation.definitionFit: A figure of five digits, a myriad, is plainly a big count, though the definition is vague.

clue.text: Plank fixer treated with elaterin

indicators.note: something treated has been worked on and changed in form

blocks.note: taken as written, a bitter compound from the squirting cucumber

explanation.surface: A carpenter's fastener has been coated with a chemical.
explanation.walkthrough: Elaterin is an obscure purgative, chosen because its letters fit; it looks like a preservative for wood.
explanation.definitionFit: A treenail is a wooden peg driven through timbers, used especially in shipbuilding to fasten planks.

clue.text: Neologism about the end of April in America

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece wraps another
an end is the final point, so only the last letter is kept

blocks.note: a neologism is a newly coined word
the final letter of April

explanation.surface: A fresh American coinage appears in late April.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Neologism' gives two words, NEW WORD, and the wrapping happens around its last letter but one.
explanation.definitionFit: The Americas were called the New World by European explorers, as opposed to the Old World of Europe, Asia and Africa.

clue.text: South African bird with no tail

indicators.note: without its tail a word loses its final letter

blocks.note: ZA is the international code for South Africa
a grebe is a diving water bird

explanation.surface: A bird from South Africa is missing its tail feathers.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital of Croatia belongs to the preamble's set.
explanation.definitionFit: Croatia's capital city is one of the thirteen European capitals the preamble groups together without separate definitions.

clue.text: Then he should get a good degree

blocks.clueFragment: Then he should get a good degree
blocks.note: surface reading: a student who meets some condition will graduate with good honours
setter's reading; if a student reads well, then he should get a good degree

explanation.walkthrough: In Britain you 'read' a subject at university. The clue is the second half of a sentence whose first half is the answer read as French. The capital of Portugal is one of the preamble's set.
explanation.definitionFit: Portugal's capital city is one of the thirteen European capitals the preamble groups together without separate definitions.

clue.text: Blow hot and cold, protected by poet with Asian drink's backing

indicators.note: what is protected is surrounded by its guard
backing up means going in the opposite direction

blocks.note: H for hot, as on a tap
C for cold, as on a tap
taken as written
arak or arrack is a spirit distilled in Asia

explanation.surface: A poet who blows hot and cold takes a drink of Asian liquor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Blow hot and cold' looks like the idiom for wavering, but 'Blow' alone is the definition; the hot and cold letters sit inside the poet before everything is turned round.
explanation.definitionFit: A sharp strike with the edge of the hand, as used in martial arts, is a kind of punch or hit.

clue.text: Security said first

indicators.note: what is said is heard rather than read

blocks.note: an anchor is a source of security
A is first-class, the top grade

explanation.surface: Safety, someone declares, comes before everything.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital of Turkey is one of the preamble's set.
explanation.definitionFit: Turkey's capital city is one of the thirteen European capitals the preamble groups together without separate definitions.

clue.text: Girl grabbing silver

indicators.note: to grab is to seize and hold, so one piece is held inside

blocks.note: Prue is a girl's name
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A girl snatches the silverware.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital of the Czech Republic is one of the preamble's set.
explanation.definitionFit: The Czech Republic's capital city is one of the thirteen European capitals the preamble groups together without separate definitions.

clue.text: See 10
Comrade Livingstone elected, prepared for the job?

blocks.note: bro, brother, is a comrade
Ken Livingstone, the left-wing former Mayor of London
a candidate who is elected is in

explanation.surface: Red Ken Livingstone wins office, ready to take on the job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Comrade' suits the left-wing Livingstone, but it only supplies the opening.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone broken in has been trained and accustomed to a task, like a horse made ready for work.

clue.text: In Rome I love to be back with a simple form of life

indicators.note: going back means travelling in the opposite direction

blocks.note: amo is Latin for I love
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A lover in Rome longs to return to a simpler life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In Rome' asks for the Latin: amo, the first word every Latin pupil conjugates.
explanation.definitionFit: The amoeba is a single-celled organism, the textbook example of a primitive living creature.

clue.text: Be right back, love

indicators.note: going back means running in the opposite direction

blocks.note: taken as written
R is the abbreviation for right
love is a score of nil in tennis

explanation.surface: Someone tells a sweetheart they'll return shortly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Be right back' is a familiar sign-off, but 'back' only turns round the word after it. The capital of Germany is one of the preamble's set.
explanation.definitionFit: Germany's capital city is one of the thirteen European capitals the preamble groups together without separate definitions.

clue.text: With first last, turn to red herring

indicators.note: the answer's first letter stands last in the wordplay, so the end letter moves round to the front

blocks.note: a U is a turn, as in U-turn
a blind is a decoy meant to mislead

explanation.surface: A herring blushes on being flipped over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Red herring' looks like a fish or a false clue in itself; it is a single phrase for BLIND. The capital of Ireland belongs to the preamble's set.
explanation.definitionFit: Ireland's capital city is one of the thirteen European capitals the preamble groups together without separate definitions.
